scripts.build: npm run build -w @b2b/api && npm run build -w @b2b/gateway && npm run build -w @b2b/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @b2b/api && npm run test -w @b2b/gateway && npm run test:services
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,gateway,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @b2b/api" "npm run dev -w @b2b/gateway" "cross-env VITE_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:4010 npm run dev -w @b2b/web"
scripts.test:services: npm run test -w @b2b/svc-auth && npm run test -w @b2b/svc-tenant && npm run test -w @b2b/svc-audit && npm run test -w @b2b/svc-notification && npm run test -w @b2b/svc-iam && npm run test -w @b2b/svc-master && npm run test -w @b2b/svc-party && npm run test -w @b2b/svc-inventory && npm run test -w @b2b/svc-qc && npm run test -w @b2b/svc-procurement
scripts.dev:platform: concurrently -n api,auth,tenant,audit,notify,iam,master,party,inventory,procurement,qc,gateway,web -c blue,cyan,yellow,gray,white,red,green,magenta,cyan,yellow,blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @b2b/api" "npm run dev -w @b2b/svc-auth" "npm run dev -w @b2b/svc-tenant" "npm run dev -w @b2b/svc-audit" "npm run dev -w @b2b/svc-notification" "npm run dev -w @b2b/svc-iam" "npm run dev -w @b2b/svc-master" "npm run dev -w @b2b/svc-party" "npm run dev -w @b2b/svc-inventory" "npm run dev -w @b2b/svc-procurement" "npm run dev -w @b2b/svc-qc" "npm run dev -w @b2b/gateway" "cross-env VITE_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:4010 npm run dev -w @b2b/web"
scripts.dev:legacy: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @b2b/api" "npm run dev -w @b2b/web"
